## Quadratic (Polynominal)

```{r}
# Set seed
{set.seed(1234)
# Sample size
n <- 1e3
# Generate data
quad_df <- tibble(
  x = runif(n, 0, 10),
  y = 12 + 16*x - 2.5*x^2 + rnorm(n, sd = 25)
)
# regression
quad_reg <- lm(y ~ x + I(x^2), data = quad_df) 
coef_q_reg <- coef(quad_reg)
b1 <- coef_q_reg[2]
b2 <- coef_q_reg[3]
}
```


```{r}
p_quad <- quad_df |> 
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(
      x = x, 
      y = y)
    ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.5, 
    colour = "orange", 
    alpha = 0.5
    ) +
  geom_smooth(
    linewidth = 1.5,
    colour = "blue",
    se = FALSE
  ) +
  xlab("X") +
  ylab("Y")

suppressMessages(print(p_quad))
```

### Regression Model

```{r}
'y ~ x + I(x^2)' |> 
  as.formula() |> 
  lm(
    data = quad_df
  ) |> 
  flextable::as_flextable() |> 
  flextable::line_spacing(space = 0.5, part = "body") |> 
  flextable::line_spacing(space = 0.3, part = "footer")
```

```{r}
#| message: false
quad_df %>%  
  ggplot(
    mappin = aes(x = x, y = y)
    ) + 
  geom_point(
    colour = "orange", 
    alpha = 0.2, 
    size = 1.5) +
#NOTE: message: false seems to work now
  stat_smooth(
    method = 'lm', 
    formula = y ~ poly(x,2), 
    se = FALSE, 
    colour = "red", 
    linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
  geom_smooth(
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "blue",
    se = FALSE
  ) +
  xlab("X") + 
  ylab("Y") 
```

```{r}
reg <- lm(y ~ x + I(x^2), data = quad_df)
# Note the package, apparently many cplot() functions
margins::cplot(
  object = reg, 
  x = "x", 
  dx = "x", 
  what = "effect", 
  draw = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
# alternative
margins::cplot(
  object = reg, 
  x = "x", 
  dx = "x", 
  what = "effect", 
  draw = FALSE
  ) |> 
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(x = xvals)
    ) + 
  geom_line(
    mapping = aes(y = yvals), 
    colour = "orange", 
    linewidth = 1
    ) +
  geom_line(
    mapping = aes(y = upper), 
    linetype = 2, 
    colour = "orange", 
    linewidth = 1
    ) +
  geom_line(
    mapping = aes(y = lower), 
    linetype = 2, 
    colour = "orange", 
    linewidth = 1
    ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, 
    linetype = 1, 
    colour = "gray"
    ) +
  xlab("X") + 
  ylab("Marginal Effect")
```

```{r}
coef(reg)
```

```{r}
# peak
- coef(reg)[2]/(2 * coef(reg)[3])
```

## Predicting log models

```{r}
house_sp <- spData::house |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  select(price, yrbuilt, stories, TLA, beds, baths, lotsize, syear) |> 
  filter(syear == 1997)
```

```{r}
m_lev_lev <- paste0(
  'price ~ yrbuilt + TLA + ',
  'beds + baths + lotsize'
)
m_log_lev <- paste0(
  'log(price) ~ yrbuilt + TLA + ',
  'beds + baths + lotsize'
)
```

```{r}
house_sp |> 
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(x = price)
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10000)
```

```{r}
house_sp |> 
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(x = log(price))
  ) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1)
```

```{r}
reg_lev_lev <- house_sp %>%
  lm(
    formula = m_lev_lev,
    data = .
  )

reg_lev_lev |> 
  flextable::as_flextable() |> 
  flextable::line_spacing(space = 0.3, part = "all")
```
